theater: 滇池、嶲州與劍南道邊境

battle.name: 唐與南詔戰爭
battle.theater: 滇池、嶲州與劍南道邊境
battle.brief: 唐玄宗天寶九載（750）冬起，劍南節度使鮮于仲通、李宓先後率大軍深入雲南攻打南詔，兩役皆因糧道被斷、仰攻受挫而全軍覆沒，士卒死者六、七萬人。南詔據洱海與拓東城之險，以弓弩居高壓制唐軍攻城隊形，並借吐蕃之力合擊唐軍。安史之亂後雙方僵持數十年，最終在貞元年間重修朝貢。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 交戰一方是唐王朝及其劍南道軍鎮：正式出兵的時候由劍南節度使節制，兵源來自益州、梓州、黔中、嶲州等州縣的團練與募兵，糧秣由成都、綿州一帶的倉儲與民間轉運供應，後段改由劍南西川、劍南東川兩節度使分領。另一方是洱海地區的南詔：王庭先在太和城，後來以拓東城為東部基地，閣羅鳳以下設清平官與大將，把境內六詔各部落的部眾編為步、騎兩軍，弓弩手數量龐大，並且用象群衝陣。第三方是吐蕃：南詔向西求援後，吐蕃自青藏高原出兵，在劍南—滇池一線作戰，與南詔合擊唐軍。南詔境內同時存在吐蕃扶植的勢力與唐廷扶植的嶲州官署，戰線在雲南東部、嶲州曲靖、劍南邊境同時拉開，因此這不是兩國對打，而是唐廷、吐蕃、南詔、嶲州地方勢力四方爭棋。唐廷在西南同時要分兵防吐蕃，劍南的宿將與糧秣多被牽往隴右，滇池一線的用兵其實只是全線戰略的一角；南詔則以清平官統兵、部位分軍，據城與野戰並行，兩邊都在兵制上做過調整。
countriesEn: On one side stood the Tang dynasty together with its Jiannan military circuits. When the fighting was actually fought, it was commanded by the Jiannan jiedushi, with soldiers drawn from the tuanlian and recruited men of Yizhou, Zizhou, Qianzhong and Xizhou, and with grain and clothing drawn from the depots and transport levies of Chengdu and Mianzhou; in the later phase the circuits of Jiannan Xichuan and Jiannan Dongchuan took over the responsibility. On the other side stood Nanzhao in the Erhai region: its court sat first at Taihe city and later made Toudong city its eastern base, and under Gelo Feng and his successors the tribal contingents of the six zhao were organized into infantry and cavalry, with a very large number of bow and crossbow hands and with war elephants used to break up a formation. A third party was Tibet: after Nanzhao sued for help, Tibetan columns came down from the plateau to fight alongside Nanzhao on the Jiannan–Dianchi line. Inside Nanzhao there existed at the same time a Tibetan-backed faction and a Tang-supported magistracy at Xizhou, while the front opened simultaneously in eastern Yunnan, at Xizhou and Qujing, and on the Jiannan frontier. This was therefore not a duel between two states but a four-cornered board on which the Tang court, Tibet, Nanzhao and the local magnates of Xizhou all moved at once. At the same time the Tang had to split its forces to watch Tibet, and the veteran troops and grain of Jiannan were repeatedly drawn away towards Longyou, so that the war in the Dianchi line was only one corner of a much wider strategy; Nanzhao, for its part, ruled its troops through the qingpingguan, divided them among the weibu, and fought from walled cities and in the open at once, and both sides adjusted their military systems to meet the war.
people: 南詔方面，決定戰局的是閣羅鳳。他在天寶年間先後向唐廷上表陳情、遣使申辯，又殺死侮辱自己的嶲州刺史張虔陀，把唐軍的每一次進攻都當成擴張的機會；李宓戰死之後他仍不稱帝、不明言反唐，只以「我與唐無讎」自居，把南詔的獨立建立在唐廷自己的失策之上。他的兒子異牟尋在廣德、永泰之後重新嘗試與唐修好，貞元年間遣使入貢、請復封號。唐廷方面，劍南節度使鮮于仲通、李宓先後領兵深入，前者大敗而幾乎不能自全，後者兩度出師、兵盡於南詔境內，兩人都因此被朝廷貶黜。安史之亂以後主持善後的是劍南西川節度使韋皋，他以厚賜與冊封換取停戰，是延續數十年相安的關鍵人物。南詔後期則是勸龍晟，他於永貞元年舉兵攻唐，一度兵臨成都，最終失敗。南詔每次北進都有吐蕃在後支持，吐蕃贊普的意志幾乎決定了整場戰爭的節奏。韋皋主持修好時並非只靠封賞，前線劍南的城壘與兵備一樣冇拆，用兵與厚市並行的局面維持了近二十年。
peopleEn: On the Nanzhao side the man who decided the war was Gelo Feng. Through the Tianbao years he sent memorials to the Tang court and envoys to explain his case, and he killed the Xizhou governor Zhang Qiantuo, who had humiliated him; he turned every Tang offensive into an opportunity for expansion, and after the destruction of Li Mi's army he still refused to proclaim himself emperor or to declare open rebellion, resting the independence of Nanzhao on the Tang court's own blunders. His son Yimouxun tried again to mend relations with the Tang in the years after Guangde and Yongtai, sending envoys with tribute and asking to be enfeoffed once more. On the Tang side the Jiannan jiedushi Xianyu Zhongtong and Li Mi led the deep thrusts into the south: the first was crushed and barely escaped with his life, the second marched out twice and was destroyed inside Nanzhao territory, and both were punished and demoted afterwards. The man who managed the aftermath after the An Lushan rebellion was Wei Gao, jiedushi of Jiannan Xichuan, who exchanged lavish gifts and investiture for a truce and was the key figure in the decades of quiet that followed. In later Nanzhao the ruler was Quanlongsheng, who raised an army against the Tang in the first year of Yongzhen and reached Chengdu before failing. Every Nanzhao advance into the north was backed by Tibet, and the will of the Tibetan zanpo very nearly set the tempo of the whole war. Wei Gao's settlement of the frontier did not rest on gifts alone: the stockades and garrisons in Jiannan were left standing, and a situation in which force and purchase were used together lasted for nearly twenty years.
kits: 這件兵器是秦連弩，一種用弩機把拉力儲存起來的連發弩。弩的機括先把弦拉上並扣住，射手踩下踏桿即可連續發射，不必每發都重新上弦，力道集中在守城與據壘的射位上。弩並非雲南的本地發明：滇池東岸的石寨山遺址出土了大量戰國末至西漢的銅弩機，數量在全國同期遺址中罕見，說明這一帶很早就是弩的製造與使用中心，雲南各部把弩機技術一代代傳了下去，直到南詔時代仍是主力。傳入中原的連弩在漢末三國由曹魏工匠馬鈞改良，可以連發數十矢；唐承此制，《唐六典》《太白陰經》都把弩列為內府與外府的主要裝備，出征時按人配發單機弩，攻城則有雲梯、飛樓、撞車與投石砲配合。南詔與唐軍在太和城、鄧川、拓東城一帶的反覆攻防之中，弩的容錯最關鍵：進攻方仰攻時最怕頭頂的連發弩，而防守方只要有幾挺連弩，就能把城牆外的攻擊隊形壓成散兵。弩箭多以竹木為桿、銅鐵為鏃，雲南石寨山一帶出土的大量銅弩機與冶銅遺址，說明當地自備弩具與修造的能力，並非全靠外運。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Qin repeating crossbow, a crossbow whose mechanism stores the draw weight so that it can fire shot after shot. The trigger mechanism is cocked and latched in advance, and the shooter releases the catch with a foot lever, so that no re-cocking is needed between shots and the effort is concentrated on the firing positions of a walled post or a fortified camp. The crossbow was not a Yunnan invention: the site of Shizhaishan on the eastern shore of Dianchi has yielded a large quantity of bronze crossbow triggers dating from the late Warring States to the Western Han, a number unusual among contemporary sites nationwide, which shows that this area was early on one of the centers of crossbow manufacture and use in China; the Yunnan tribes carried that trigger technology down through the generations, and it was still a main arm in the Nanzhao era. The repeating crossbow that reached the central plain was improved in the late Han and Three Kingdoms by the Cao Wei craftsman Ma Jun, who built a device able to discharge tens of bolts in sequence. The Tang inherited the system, and both the Tangliudian and the Taibai Yinjing list the crossbow among the principal equipment of the inner and outer depots; on campaign the single-shot crossbow was issued man by man, while the siege train brought scaling ladders, flying towers, battering rams and stone-throwing trebuchets. In the repeated offensives and defenses around Taihe city, Dengechuan and Toudong city, the reliability of the crossbow was decisive: an attacking force climbing a wall fears the repeating crossbows above it more than anything else, and a defender needs only a few of them to scatter the assaulting formation outside the walls. Crossbow bolts were mostly shafted in bamboo or wood and headed in copper or iron, and the large quantity of bronze crossbow triggers and the smelting remains found around Shizhaishan show that the region could make and repair its own crossbow gear rather than depending entirely on imports.
tactics: 唐軍的戰術是節度使集中大軍自劍南出發，走石門、龍尾、鐵門等山道由北向南壓進，直取洱海與滇池；沿途靠驛道與民夫轉運糧秣，宿營依託驛站。這種打法的好處是兵力集中、聲勢浩大，壞處是隊列被山谷拉成數十里長的一條線，一斷糧道就整條線失去戰鬥力。敗績幾乎都發生在唐軍深入之後：退路被南詔與吐蕃的遊騎截斷，前進則被城牆與弩手擋住，糧盡之後大批士兵餓著潰散，後衛再回頭掩殺，等於把整支軍隊送掉。南詔的戰術是據險設伏：在峽谷出口與城郊集中兵力，以弓弩居高射擊，之後用象群和騎兵反擊潰兵，專打唐軍的斷糧與退路。到安史之亂後，唐廷放棄野戰，改為在劍南築壘固守、派將扼守大度口等出入孔道，並派兵護送糧隊；同時由韋皋出面，以封賞和贖買維持邊界。唐軍的糧道自成都經漢州、黔中接上嶲州，越往南驛站越疏；南詔則用縱深換時間，把唐軍拖到糧盡，再以逸待勞。
tacticsEn: The Tang tactic was to concentrate a large army under the jiedushi and march south from Jiannan along mountain tracks such as Shimen, Longwei and Tiemen toward Erhai and Dianchi, with grain and clothing moved forward by the relay post and by civilian porters, the army quartering at the courier stations along the road. The strength of this approach was concentration and a threatening mass of men; its weakness was that the column was drawn out by the valleys into a single line tens of li long, and once the supply road was cut the whole line lost its fighting power. The defeats almost always came after the Tang army had penetrated deep: the route of withdrawal was intercepted by Nanzhao and Tibetan raiding parties, the advance was blocked by walls and crossbowmen, and when the grain ran out large numbers of soldiers starved and scattered, while the rearguard killing its way back through them only threw the whole army away. The Nanzhao tactic was to hold the ground and ambush: massing troops at the exits of the gorges and in the countryside outside the cities, shooting down from height with bow and crossbow, then counterattacking the broken troops with elephants and cavalry, always striking the Tang grain convoy and its line of retreat. After the An Lushan rebellion the Tang court gave up open-field battle and built stockades in Jiannan instead, posting commanders to hold the exits such as Dadu kou, and escorting the grain convoys; at the same time Wei Gao held the frontier in place through gifts, payments and the purchase of peace. The Tang supply road ran from Chengdu through Hanzhou and Qianzhong to meet the line at Xizhou, and the further south it went the thinner the relay stations became; Nanzhao in turn used depth to buy time, dragging the Tang out until its grain ran out and then meeting a spent enemy on ground of its own choosing.
data: 兵員與損耗是這場戰爭最刺眼的數字。天寶九載（750），劍南節度使鮮于仲通領兵八萬自劍南入滇，與南詔在洱海一線接戰，《資治通鑑》記「大敗，士卒死者六萬餘」；天寶十載（751）與十二載（753），接任的劍南節度使李宓又兩度領兵深入，每次出動的兵都在五萬上下，通鑑記李宓敗回時「士卒死者六、七萬人」。兩役相加，唐軍前後折損近二十萬之眾，數字雖未必逐一核實，卻足以說明劍南一個州府的兵源與府庫被一次打空。距離方面，從劍南首府到嶲州、滇池，軍行要走上千里的山道，後勤線比前線長得多；轉運一季軍糧要動用數萬民夫與牲畜，沿途設驛、置倉，一步都不能斷。天寶中後期劍南每年為西南戰事支出大量布帛與軍糧，蜀地百姓的賦役負擔隨之加重。南詔一方每次出動的兵力在數萬之眾，它們的戰果則寫在唐廷的損失單上。兩次出兵相隔約一年，其間朝廷在劍南各州再抽丁、再籌糧，沒有一次改走海路或運河；765年南詔北進時，自雲南到成都邊界要走數百里，馬匹與糧車更多靠人力馱運。
dataEn: Troop numbers and losses are the most striking figures of this war. In the ninth year of Tianbao (750) the Jiannan jiedushi Xianyu Zhongtong took eighty thousand men from Jiannan into Yunnan and engaged Nanzhao on the Erhai line; the Zizhi Tongjian records a crushing defeat in which 'more than sixty thousand of the soldiers were dead.' In the tenth year of Tianbao (751) and again in the twelfth (753) his successor Li Mi marched deep into the country twice, each time with about fifty thousand men, and the Tongjian records that when Li Mi came back 'sixty to seventy thousand of the soldiers had been killed.' Added together, the two campaigns cost the Tang army close to two hundred thousand men; whether every figure was checked is doubtful, but it is enough to show that the manpower and the treasury of a single prefecture in Jiannan were emptied in one stroke. As for distance, from the seat of Jiannan to Xizhou and Dianchi the columns had to march more than a thousand li over mountain tracks, so the line of supply was far longer than the front; moving one season of grain into the field employed tens of thousands of porters and draft animals, with relay stations and depots set up along the way, and not one stage of it could be broken. In the middle and later years of Tianbao, Jiannan spent large quantities of cloth and provisions on the southwestern war, and the tax and corvée burden of the Sichuan people grew accordingly. Nanzhao put tens of thousands into the field on each of its offensives, and its results are written in the Tang's own casualty lists. The two expeditions were about a year apart, and between them the court drew more men and more grain from the prefectures of Jiannan, never once switching to a sea route or a canal; when the Nanzhao army marched north in 765 it had several hundred li to cover from Yunnan to the borders of Chengdu, and its horses and grain carts were moved largely on human backs.
cause: 開戰有三層原因，缺一不可。第一層是體制：唐在開元二十六年（738）冊封閣羅鳳為雲南王，把南詔納入朝貢體系，視之為西南藩屬；南詔則需要這個名分來壓服六詔各部，同時不願受唐廷在嶲州等地的日常羈束。羈束最終變成衝突：嶲州刺史張虔陀向閣羅鳳索取財貨、凌辱其使者，閣羅鳳殺了他，唐廷卻把責任推給南詔。第二層是玄宗前期的邊疆外交：南詔屢次請和、請罪，朝廷一律拒絕，甚至扣押使者、誣稱南詔犯邊，把原本可以調解的地方糾紛升級為全面戰爭；反覆的敗績又讓唐廷用兵愈多，陷入越打越被動的循環。第三層是吐蕃的介入：南詔在唐軍連續打壓之下向吐蕃求援，吐蕃出高原兵與南詔合流，唐廷一次遠征變成兩面作戰，戰爭規模因此超出任何一方的原計畫。更深一層是唐廷的注意力被吐蕃吸走：同期吐蕃在隴右與劍南兩線施壓，益州既要留防又要朝貢，唐廷仍逼南詔加重貢賦並派官入南詔查帳，衝突因此無處可退。
causeEn: There were three levels of cause, and the war needed all three. The first was structural: in the twenty-sixth year of Kaiyuan (738) the Tang invested Gelo Feng as King of Yunnan and drew Nanzhao into the tributary system, treating it as a southwestern dependency; Nanzhao needed that title to hold the tribes of the six zhao in check, but did not want the daily supervision of the Tang authorities in places such as Xizhou. That supervision finally turned into collision: the Xizhou governor Zhang Qiantuo demanded goods and payments from Gelo Feng and humiliated his envoys, Gelo Feng killed him, and the Tang court placed the blame on Nanzhao. The second was the frontier diplomacy of the early Xuanzong reign: Nanzhao repeatedly asked for peace and asked to be pardoned, and the court refused every time, even detaining envoys and accusing Nanzhao of a border raid, so that a local quarrel which could have been mediated was escalated into a general war; and the repeated defeats then pushed the court to send ever more men, locking it into a cycle in which the more it fought the worse it did. The third was Tibetan involvement: under repeated Tang pressure Nanzhao appealed to Tibet for help, Tibet sent troops down from the plateau to join Nanzhao, and a single distant expedition by the Tang became a two-front war, so that the scale of the conflict outgrew the original plan of any one party. Deeper still, the Tang court's attention was being pulled toward Tibet, which was pressing on both the Longyou and the Jiannan fronts, so that Yizhou had to keep a garrison and send tribute at the same time; the court nonetheless demanded heavier tribute from Nanzhao and sent officials into Nanzhao to audit its accounts, and the quarrel was left with no way to retreat.
impact: 這場戰爭留下的東西比勝負更多。第一，劍南被打空：兩次大敗折損近二十萬人，劍南的精兵與府庫幾乎耗盡，等到天寶十四載（755）安史之亂爆發，蜀中再抽不出足夠的兵去援關中，這正是西南方面對戰局最致命的影響。第二，南詔坐大：唐廷無力南顧的十幾年裡，南詔佔了嶲州、曲靖、拓東城，壘土築城、開闢滇中農田，取得當地的銅、鐵與馬匹，逐步成為獨立的西南政權，這種政權形態一直延續到九世紀末的大理國。第三，技術與物產的流動：弩機與冶鐵技術在戰爭中沿著軍隊與使節的路線傳播，滇池兩岸的弩文化因此不斷加深。第四，外交秩序：唐廷在貞元年間重新建立「冊封—朝貢」的框架，以南詔進貢方物與馬匹換取邊界安寧，這套框架維持到永貞元年（805）勸龍晟攻唐才告破裂。同期南詔在拓東城立《南詔德化碑》，碑文用漢文追述閣羅鳳事蹟，刻意保留奉唐正朔的名分；形式上稱臣而實質獨立的雙重格局，就是這場戰爭最長久的產物。
impactEn: What this war left behind is more than a winner and a loser. First, Jiannan was emptied: two great defeats cost close to two hundred thousand men, and the region's trained soldiers and its treasury were nearly spent, so that when the An Lushan rebellion broke out in the fourteenth year of Tianbao (755) Sichuan could no longer find enough troops to send to the relief of Guanzhong, and that was the most fatal southwestern effect on the war as a whole. Second, Nanzhao grew: during the more than ten years in which the Tang court could not look south, Nanzhao took Xizhou, Qujing and Toudong city, raised earthen fortifications and built cities, opened up farmland in the Dianzhong plain, obtained the local copper, iron and horses, and gradually became an independent southwestern polity, a form of state that ran on into the Dali kingdom of the late ninth century. Third, the movement of technology and materials: crossbow mechanisms and iron-smelting know-how travelled along the routes of armies and envoys during the war, and the crossbow culture on both shores of Dianchi deepened accordingly. Fourth, the diplomatic order: the Tang court rebuilt the framework of investiture and tribute in the Zhenyuan era, exchanging Nanzhao's tribute of local goods and horses for quiet on the frontier, and this framework held until Quanlongsheng's attack on the Tang in the first year of Yongzhen (805) broke it apart. In the same years Nanzhao raised the Nanzhao Dehua Stele at Toudong city, its inscription written in Chinese characters and recounting the deeds of Gelo Feng, deliberately preserving the formula of acknowledging the Tang calendar; a state formally subject yet in fact independent is the longest-lived product of this war.
result: 分階段看：750年至755年是唐軍連敗的四年，鮮于仲通、李宓兩度折戟，南詔取得洱海與滇池的制高點，閣羅鳳卻仍以「我與唐無讎」自居，保留了向唐稱臣的門面。755年安史之亂爆發之後戰事停滯，南詔乘勢取嶲州、拓東城，唐廷只剩劍南幾處堡壘，雙方形成僵持。765年（永泰元年）南詔大軍北進，攻掠西川諸州，兵鋒逼近成都，因唐軍據險阻截與糧秣不繼而退回雲南，這是南詔軍隊走得最遠的一次。此後近三十年是拉鋸與談判：韋皋以厚賜羈縻，異牟尋遣使謝罪，貞元十年（794）雙方恢復冊封與朝貢，南詔重新進貢方物與馬，邊界維持了近二十年的相對安寧。永貞元年（805）勸龍晟舉兵攻唐、兵臨成都而敗，關係再度破裂。長期看，南詔未被平定，唐朝在這場戰爭中沒有得到臣服，卻失去了對西南的一次壟斷；南詔則在九世紀末演為大理國，把唐代的羈縻制度與西南民族格局一併帶進了後世。自765年退回雲南之後，南詔再未成功北進成都，卻也再未真正歸附，直到902年國滅。
resultEn: Taken stage by stage: from 750 to 755 were four years of repeated Tang defeats, with Xianyu Zhongtong and Li Mi both ruined, and Nanzhao taking the heights of Erhai and Dianchi, though Gelo Feng still styled himself 'I have no feud with the Tang' and kept the appearance of a subject. When the An Lushan rebellion broke out in 755 the fighting froze, Nanzhao seized Xizhou and Toudong city while the Tang retained only a few stockades in Jiannan, and the two sides settled into a stalemate. In 765, the first year of Yongtai, a Nanzhao army marched north, raided the prefectures of Xichuan and came close to Chengdu, and was driven back into Yunnan because the Tang held the passes and because its own provisions ran out; that was the furthest a Nanzhao army ever reached. The following nearly thirty years were a mixture of attrition and negotiation: Wei Gao held the frontier with gifts and indulgence, Yimouxun sent envoys to apologize, and in the tenth year of Zhenyuan (794) investiture and tribute were restored, Nanzhao again sending local goods and horses, and the frontier enjoyed some twenty years of relative quiet. In 805, the first year of Yongzhen, Quanlongsheng raised an army against the Tang, reached Chengdu and was defeated, and the relationship broke once more. In the long run Nanzhao was never pacified: the Tang won no submission in this war but lost its monopoly over the southwest, while Nanzhao grew into the Dali kingdom by the end of the ninth century, carrying the Tang jimi system and the southwestern ethnic pattern together into the later ages. After the withdrawal of 765 the Nanzhao armies never again reached Chengdu successfully, yet they were never truly resubmitted either, right up to the fall of the state in 902.
